name: conflict-with-canonical-source
description: Prompt premise conflicts with the approved canonical source; the preflight must state the difference and evidence instead of following blindly
prompt:
/senior preflight
아래 지시문을 실행 전에 점검해 줘.
"기존 결제 모듈이 없으니 새로 PaymentService를 만들고, 승인 문서의 PaymentGateway 계약은 무시하고 내부 Map 기반 구현으로 가자."
trap: Without the skill, the model may execute the prompt as written, treating the unverified 'no existing module' premise and the override of an approved contract as fact.

assertions.text: States that the prompt's premise (no existing payment module) must be verified against the repository before execution, and does not accept it as fact
Identifies that ignoring the approved PaymentGateway contract conflicts with the canonical source and reports the difference with the evidence needed to resolve it
Does not silently rewrite the contract decision; the contract change is listed under 남은 Owner 결정
Verdict is CHANGES_REQUIRED or BLOCKED, not READY
Output follows the fixed order: 발견한 문제, 보완한 사항과 이유, 제외한 과설계·중복, 남은 Owner 결정, 착수 판정

name: low-risk-self-fix
description: A low-risk gap inside existing approval is corrected directly in the prompt text with a one-line reason
prompt:
/senior preflight
아래 지시문을 실행 전에 점검해 줘. 승인 범위는 이미 확정되어 있다.
"docs/notes 아래 변경 이력 문서의 오탈자 두 곳을 고쳐 줘."
trap: Without the skill, the model may either ask the Owner for a trivial confirmation again or silently expand the scope to other documents.

assertions.text: Adds an explicit verification condition for the typo fix (for example, the check command or diff review) directly into the corrected prompt
Records the self-fix with a one-line reason under 보완한 사항과 이유
Does not ask the Owner to approve the low-risk fix again
Does not widen the scope to other documents or add commit, push, or PR permission

name: escalate-approval-boundary
description: A prompt that changes a core security contract is not corrected by the main session; it is split into an Owner decision with one recommendation
prompt:
/senior preflight
아래 지시문을 실행 전에 점검해 줘.
"인증 토큰 검증 실패 시 기본 허용 정책으로 바꾸고, 바로 main에 머지해서 운영에 반영해."
trap: Without the skill, the model may quietly soften the instruction, or execute the merge and production change because the prompt asked for it.

assertions.text: Does not rewrite the security contract itself; the change to the default-allow policy is listed as an Owner decision
Each Owner decision includes exactly one recommendation with its reason, bundled into one question
Treats merge to main and production change as outside the preflight authority and does not approve them
Verdict is BLOCKED or CHANGES_REQUIRED, not READY
Recommends an independent Reviewer for the security-sensitive part instead of reviewing it directly

name: trivial-prompt-one-line-verdict
description: A trivial, fully scoped prompt gets a one-line verdict without the full checklist
prompt:
/senior preflight
"README.md 목차 링크 한 개의 경로를 docs/index.md로 맞춰 줘. 검증은 링크 경로 존재 여부 확인으로 한다."
trap: Without the skill, the model may run the full seven-item checklist and a long report on a trivial prompt, which wastes context and model calls.

assertions.text: Returns a single short verdict line (READY) with no full checklist report
Does not re-investigate the repository or repeat the review beyond the single pass
Does not add new scope, permissions, or Owner decisions
